meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (offshore International Company regime administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common-law base with statutory/customary-law elements; Unitary National system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa–New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (in force; relief generally reserved for residents, with limited effect for tax-exempt International Companies)
Samoa–Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (in force); Samoa–United States Tax Information Exchange Agreement (in force)
Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (Samoa participation for transparency/EOIR purposes)
PACER Plus trade agreement (in force for Samoa; trade framework, no standalone investment-protection chapter)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (Samoa), as amended; International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, together with SIFA AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes for International Companies and Registered Agents; beneficial-ownership records are held by the licensed registered agent and are accessible to the SIFA Registrar and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each individual shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin state is an Apostille Contracting Party; otherwise Consular Legalization via the Samoan High Commission/Embassy or authorized honorary consul

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing bank in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where the licensed agent requires heightened verification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / register extract for any corporate shareholder in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country corporate registry or licensed registered agent of the corporate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization consistent with origin-jurisdiction rules

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from the applicant's financing bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the shareholder or UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct confidential transmission to the Samoan licensed agent; apostille not required for bank-to-agent professional correspondence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source-of-funds and source-of-wealth statement, supported by documentary evidence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized professional advisor or accounting firm of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized statement; Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization where required by the licensed agent's risk policy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory CDD under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018: each shareholder and UBO must be screened at onboarding against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK sanctions lists, Australian DFAT consolidated list, and Samoa domestic sanctions/denied-persons alerts; PEP status is verified using global PEP databases, adverse-media checks are performed, and source-of-funds documentation is obtained; PEPs and high-risk persons require senior management approval of the licensed agent, enhanced ongoing monitoring, and STR filing to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit where any suspicion arises; the standard is consistent with FATF Recommendation 10 and 12 and the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering expectations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - Registrar of International Companies name-availability search and e-filing via the licensed registered-agent portal; cross-check against the domestic companies register maintained by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The International Companies Act 1987 requires the name to be expressed in roman (Latin) characters; Samoan and English are preferred; a proposed Chinese or other non-Latin script name must be filed together with a certified romanized transliteration and an official English translation approved by the licensed agent; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing international or domestic company name or to a reserved name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On refusal under section 9 of the International Companies Act 1987, the licensed agent may (i) request written reasons and file an alternative name within 14 days; (ii) submit an administrative review application to the SIFA Registrar within 21 days of the refusal notification; (iii) appeal the Registrar's decision to the Minister responsible for finance, whose decision is final; in commercial practice, an applicant should simultaneously reserve a fallback name, as the full review window may exceed the standard 30-day reservation period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully permissible for this industry: the International Company must at all times maintain a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa at the agent's street address (e.g., Lotemau Centre, Apia); no physical office, employees, or infrastructure in Samoa is required for the EMR cloud SaaS business; the international company is statutorily prohibited from carrying on domestic business within Samoa, and its cross-border software-as-a-service activities are consistent with the offshore regime
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 2% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the International Company's own premises, which is effectively nil because the company holds no Samoan premises; inspection risk is concentrated at the licensed registered-agent level (SIFA desk reviews and on-site audits of agents), rising to approximately 15% only if PEP flags, sanctions alerts, AML reporting, or adverse regulatory findings emerge

Payment-rail readiness: introduction to licensed offshore banking provider for bank-transfer settlement and due-diligence pack processing (Stripe Billing not directly available to Samoa-domiciled ICs)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for corporate bank referral and KYC pack compilation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Samoa International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), particularly ss. 6-8 (Incorporation), s. 9 (Registered Office), s. 24 (Shares), and s. 47 (Directors); supplemental Business Licences Act 1998
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa, acting through SIFA-licensed registered agents
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Company Constitution) executed by the subscriber and filed with the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital prescribed; a single share of no par value may be issued; no escrow or capital deposit requirement applicable under the International Companies Act 1987
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: (1) the allotment of one Ordinary Share of no par value to the founding subscriber, as recorded in the Memorandum and Articles of Association, be and is hereby ratified; (2) the registered office situated at the licensed Registered Agent's address in Apia, Samoa, be and is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory registered office; (3) [Founder Director] be appointed as sole Director and [Corporate Secretary] be appointed as Secretary; (4) the bank mandate authorizing signatories to open corporate accounts and to complete the Business Licence application be issued; and (5) the Director be empowered to file all statutory returns and pay applicable fees under the International Companies Act 1987.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage Licensed Registered Agent and Reserve Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) licensed corporate/registered agent in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a SIFA-licensed registered agent in Apia to act as statutory registered agent and provide the registered office address. Execute the registered agent engagement letter specifying the office address as the registered office for service of process and statutory notices. The registered agent must attest its acceptance of appointment for submission to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation of the registered agent
SIFA licence of the registered agent
Consent to act as registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA queries the agent's licence status or the address, substitute another licensed agent and resubmit the consent letter promptly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through the registered agent proposing the company name with required suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd'. Ensure the name is not misleading, undesirable, or identical to an existing registered name. Obtain formal name clearance in writing prior to filing the charter.
required_dossiers: Authority to act from the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of name refusal or conditional clearance, propose up to three alternate names for sequential re-screening at no additional material delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent under supervision of the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company Constitution comprising Articles addressing share capital (single no-par-value share), permitted objects, director powers, and the limitation of liability. Execute the Memorandum and Articles by the subscriber in the presence of a witness, with the registered agent coordinating attestation and date of execution.
required_dossiers: Statement of permitted business objects (ISIC 6201 EMR SaaS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar returns the charter for defects, amend the affected clauses with the registered agent and re-execute the corrected version with a new execution date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Charter and Submit Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Have the registered agent lodge the executed Memorandum and Articles, accompanied by the statutory declaration of compliance, registered agent consent, and the official filing fee of USD 300. Track confirmation of filing and retain the stamped acknowledgment for the incorporation certificate.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Proof of payment of filing fee (USD 300)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to incomplete dossiers or defects, file an amendment with supporting documents within the notice period; resubmission is processed within 3-5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Certificate of Incorporation and Issue Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987. Verify the company number, name, and date of incorporation; prepare the corporate kit containing the certificate, charter, share certificate, board resolution register, and company seal.
required_dossiers: Share certificate for the founding subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains any clerical error, apply to the Registrar for rectification under the Act with a cover letter and the original certificate; expected correction within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Hold First Board Meeting, Adopt Resolutions, and Appoint Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board under the International Companies Act 1987
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or execute the written consent resolution) ratifying share allotment, adopting the registered office, appointing the Director, Secretary, and bank signatories, and authorising the Business Licence filing. Record the minutes and file the officer appointment details with the registered agent for the statutory register.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or written resolution
Notification of director and secretary appointments
Bank account mandate and signatory list
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent identifies an administrative omission in officer records, execute a supplemental written resolution and resubmit the corrected register within 24 hours.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Registry Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for 'IT and Software Services – Healthcare Clinical Workflow (EMR SaaS)' issued under the Business Licences Act 1998

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Pure cloud software service with no manufacturing plant, no effluent discharge, and no physical industrial installation; a self-declaration of exemption accompanies the business licence application
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for physical wastewater or VOC emissions; digital infrastructure must comply with ISO/IEC 27001 alignment, and medical data handling must follow Samoa Health Sector Information Security Guidelines, including encryption of patient records at rest and in transit and zero-default password policies

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Issuance of a commercial occupancy certificate from the Apia building control authority confirming structural load inspections; fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority for all office premises; labour workplace clearance confirming safe egress, electrical safety, and adequate ventilation under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2002

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), established under the Samoa Revenue Authority Act 2013 and overseen by the Ministry for Revenue; official e-Services portal: https://www.sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned International Company (IC), the applicant first completes IC incorporation with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), appoints a licensed registered agent in Samoa, and files the certified charter, certificate of incorporation, and beneficial-owner particulars. Because an IC is a non-resident tax-exempt entity, it ordinarily requires no income-tax TIN; where a Samoan GST taxable activity is nevertheless derived, the entity must register online via the SRA portal or by Form SRA 200, supplying the incorporation documents, registered agent details, foreign owner identification, and projected turnover. The SRA issues a TIN within approximately 5 business days; GST registration is effective from the date the WST 80,000 threshold is met or exceeded.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election is available to Samoa International Companies. The principal statutory election is conversion into a domestic company under the International Companies Act 1988, which terminates the statutory 20-year tax exemption, and the related option to align the IC's accounting reference date for SRA administrative filings. Samoa's Income Tax Act 2018 and Tax Administration Act 2018 incorporate OECD BEPS-aligned hybrid mismatch and anti-double-non-taxation rules, so cross-border payments under the EMR SaaS model cannot rely on a mismatch election to achieve exemption in both Samoa and the recipient jurisdiction.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Goods and Services Tax (GST) — a value-added consumption tax administered under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2017 (replacing the previous VAGST regime)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 80,000 (SAT 80,000) of taxable supplies in any 12-month period; non-resident suppliers of remote services (including cloud-based EMR software) are caught by the same economic registration threshold for supplies made to Samoan-resident recipients
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa currently imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, no mandatory e-invoicing platform, and no API/digital-stamping obligation. Registered persons must issue a prescribed GST tax invoice, in paper or electronic form, within 28 days of supply, and must file GST returns and remit GST electronically through the SRA e-Service portal at the frequencies (monthly, two-monthly, or six-monthly) directed by the Commissioner.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported tangible goods and 'international services' qualify for a 0% GST rate. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident who is not in Samoa at the time of supply and the services are performed and contractually used entirely outside Samoa; this covers offshore EMR SaaS subscriptions, HIPAA cloud software licensing, and software-related support provided to foreign medical clinics. The supplier must retain evidence of the recipient's non-residence and of overseas use/benefit, and a GST-registered exporter may claim input-tax credits and refunds for GST-inclusive costs attributable to those zero-rated exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SRA customs entry for export) endorsed by Samoa Customs
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing the physical movement of exported goods
Inward Remittance Certificate or Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) bank credit advice evidencing hard-currency receipt
Commercial invoice and signed SaaS/EMR service agreement identifying the non-resident client
Certificate/declaration of the overseas recipient's non-residence and use of the software outside Samoa
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The SRA can reopen returns within 4 years (7 years for fraud or willful evasion), claw back the unremitted 15% GST with interest, and impose shortfall penalty tax of up to 150% for intentional evasion or 75% for gross negligence, plus monthly late-payment penalties. Deliberate falsification of export zero-rating documents attracts criminal prosecution with fines up to SAT 100,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years, and the responsible IC's registered agent may be sanctioned administratively under the International Companies Act 1988.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) – Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1972
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa maintains exchange controls on resident Tālā accounts; the International Company (IC) is treated as non-resident for exchange control purposes, allowing free convertibility in foreign currency and unimpeded profit remittance offshore without CBS approval. WST is convertible for non-residents only through authorized dealers. Capital account transactions by non-resident ICs are unrestricted, while resident entities face partial restrictions requiring CBS authorization for certain inward/outward investment flows. Profit remittance for the EMR SaaS IC is not subject to dividend withholding tax or capital repatriation approval, provided the IC maintains non-resident status under the International Companies Act 1987.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must surrender 100% of export proceeds to an authorized bank in Samoa within 30 days of receipt, unless an exemption is granted by CBS. The WS IC, being non-resident, is not subject to surrender obligations for its foreign-currency EMR SaaS subscription receipts. If foreign currency is physically remitted into the IC's Samoan bank account, conversion to WST at prevailing exchange rates is permitted without mandatory surrender; however, transfers to local resident payees requiring WST may be subject to bank-level exchange control declarations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific Limited (Samoa Branch)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., those licensed under a reputable FCA, FinCEN, or other recognized regime) can be selectively used for receivables collection in USD/EUR via virtual IBAN facilities, especially for B2B SaaS billing from global clinics. However, Samoa does not license or recognize EMIs as banks, and any domestic WST disbursement or operational funding in Samoa must clear through a commercial bank authorized by CBS. Legal constraints: EMI accounts cannot hold WST without a local banking partner; significant outbound flows from an EMI to a Samoan IC may trigger enhanced AML review due to payment-intermediary risk. Recommended as a secondary card and subscription-convenience rail, not as a substitute for primary corporate banking.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner is generally mandated for initial onboarding with Samoan banks. A fully remote opening is possible for an existing group relationship with a licensed bank or through a SIFA-licensed registered agent that provides a certified introduction and apostilled corporate documents. ANZ and BSP accept video-based KYC interviews combined with notarized board resolutions; Samoa Commercial Bank typically requires an in-country introducer. For the WS IC, the authorized director should appear at the CBS-compliant branch or schedule a notarized remote interview with documentary verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained large inbound shareholder capital injection to Capital Escrow Account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution approving share issuance; signed subscription agreement and share register; source-of-funds statements from the remitting shareholder's bank; Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association; Certificate of Good Standing issued by Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA); and an updated ultimate beneficial ownership declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency outbound disbursements to cloud vendors, foreign contractors, and licensing partners tied to medical data processing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed service agreements with Google Cloud or AWS; itemized invoices with milestone/task validation; HIPAA/HITRUST compliance attestation; ISO 27001 certificate and data-processing impact assessment; contractor or consultant agreements with clear deliverables; audited management accounts demonstrating commensurate revenue; evidence of WHT or no-WHT eligibility under Samoa tax regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk medical software industry triggering PEP or adverse-media screening on beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SIFA-issued license and an updated register of directors/shareholders; detailed medical-records hosting agreement establishing data custody and HITECH obligations; external cybersecurity audit report; Data Protection Officer appointment; board policy on healthcare compliance and breach notification; personal net-worth and background-dossier references from a pre-existing banking relationship.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant route uses SWIFT MT103 with field 70 referencing /SHARE/ and the IC's share subscription number. The remittance must be in USD/EUR to an IC foreign-currency account at ANZ/BSP Samoa. Beneficiary bank will require a board resolution, updated share register, and certificate of bonus/member contribution to attribute funds to issued capital. No CBS approval is necessary because the IC is non-resident and the inflow is an equity contribution; however, the bank may submit an exchange-control declaration for regulatory statistics. The beneficiary account name must match the IC register; funds exceeding USD 50,000 typically trigger a compliance review and require evidence of business purpose.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for international SaaS trade settlements, supporting USD/EUR/GBP via ANZ/BSP/Samoa Commercial Bank correspondent networks. For domain purchases, cloud licensing, and software developers' compensation, direct MT103 transfers are preferred. Commercial letters of credit are not standard for EMR Saas; an MT700 or standby MT760 may be used when a large third-party medical module is procured, with cash collateral or uncommitted facility support. Domestic WST disbursements (payroll, rent, professional fees) are executed through local bank transfer, and once physical Samoa employees are engaged, periodic PAYE and social-levy obligations must be reported and paid via the Ministry of Revenue. All outbound payments should carry accurate end-to-end remittance information to prevent delays.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forward (USD/WST) with an authorized Samoan dealer, up to 12 months tenor, requiring an identified underlying revenue or cost exposure.
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) on WST/USD, available to non-resident IC without CBS approval, settled only in USD.

Cross-currency interest-rate or basis swap between USD and EUR, permissible for hedging liability payments to European cloud infrastructure providers, provided the swap is documented and related to a genuine commercial exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee Payment (International Company Annual License Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) – Office of the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation; no grace period beyond 28 days after the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee; continued non-payment for 3 months results in administrative strike-off and loss of legal status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Confirmation of Registered Office and Contact Details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (licensed trusteeship services provider) acting for the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: With the annual renewal filing, coinciding with the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent may withdraw representation; failure to maintain a resident registered agent leads to administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for an International Company unless the company’s constituent documents expressly require an audit; an IC is exempt from audit and financial statement filing requirements under the International Companies Act 1987, irrespective of turnover or assets
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Not mandatory; if audited voluntarily, generally International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) may be used, but no specific statutory accounting framework is imposed on International Companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Samoa’s AML/CFT Act and the International Companies Act, the registered agent must annually confirm and update beneficial ownership information; any change in members, directors, or ownership must be notified to the agent within 14 days; the agent is not required to file UBO details with the Registrar but must maintain a verified internal register for inspection by Samoa authorities
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (minutes of director and member resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable – audit exemption available; if voluntarily performed, USD 3,000 – 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — A Samoa International Company is exempt from corporate income tax under the International Companies Act 1987, as amended, and the Income Tax Act 2012. The exemption covers all income derived by the International Company, including offshore royalties, SaaS subscription revenue, interest, dividends, and capital gains.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective Samoan tax rate is 0%. No corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no dividend withholding tax, no interest withholding tax, no royalty withholding tax, no payroll tax, and no value added tax on international company income. The only recurring fiscal impost is the annual International Company government fee, which is a registry fee rather than an income tax. There is no tax holiday application process because the exemption is granted by statute.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable — A Samoa International Company is not assessable to corporate income tax and is not issued with a corporate income tax return form by the Samoa Ministry of Revenue. No income tax e-filing portal profile is required solely for the International Company.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: No corporate income tax filing frequency
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory corporate income tax filing deadline

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No corporate income tax return is filed by an exempt International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No filing action required. The exemption is automatic; a tax exemption certificate can be obtained through the resident agent if treaty or banking counterparties require formal evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Not applicable for mere non-filing of a non-existent CIT return. However, failure to obey a lawful information notice from the Ministry of Revenue or failure to maintain records may trigger civil penalties under the Income Tax Act 2012 and other enforcement measures.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IC-1 — Annual Return of an International Company, filed through the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) online portal by the licensed Samoa resident agent. The filing is a company law filing, not a tax filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation, or on the annual renewal date notified by the Registrar of International Companies. If the anniversary falls on a non-business day, the next business day is accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name of the International Company, including the required 'International Company' or 'IC' suffix.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name appearing in the certificate of incorporation. For non-resident owners, no Samoan tax identifier is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: International Company registry number assigned by the Registrar upon incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify against the incorporation certificate. This number is used for all SIFA annual return filings and fee payments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa. A physical street address in Samoa is mandatory; a post office box alone is not sufficient.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the address of the licensed resident agent if no separate physical office is maintained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the Samoa resident agent acting as the company's statutory agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must engage a SIFA-licensed resident agent; the agent is the official contact for Government correspondence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationality, passport numbers, residential addresses, and dates of appointment of all directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors may be listed with their foreign residential addresses and passport details. A minimum of one natural-person director is typical for an International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, address, and passport details of the company secretary, if appointed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The secretary may be a natural person or a licensed corporate service provider; non-residents may act as secretary unless a Samoan resident officer is required by the registrar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital information, including authorized capital, issued capital, class of shares, and currency denomination.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the share capital in the currency adopted at incorporation. There is no minimum paid-up capital requirement for a Samoa International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership declaration identifying every ultimate beneficial owner holding 25% or more of shares or control.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ultimate owners must be disclosed to the registered agent. The agent maintains a beneficial ownership register unless the declaration is filed with the SIFA under the applicable AML/CFT framework.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return attracts a late filing penalty, typically WST 500 per month or part of a month, plus the unpaid annual registry fee. Continued default for six months to one year may result in administrative strike-off and dissolution. Restoration requires payment of all arrears, a restoration fee, and any additional Civil Penalty imposed by the Registrar. Directors may also be examined personally on oath for continuing non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders under the statutory International Company exemption. No dividend withholding tax is deducted at source. If the International Company exemption is lost and the entity becomes a taxable Samoan domestic company, the statutory non-resident dividend withholding rate is 15%, subject to any applicable double tax agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa has a limited double tax agreement network. Because a Samoa International Company distributes dividends with 0% statutory withholding tax, treaty relief is not ordinarily required. Where treaty relief is necessary, the protocol is: (a) obtain an official Samoa Tax Residency Certificate from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue through the resident agent; (b) obtain the residency certificate of the foreign beneficial owner; (c) submit the withholding tax relief or refund application on the form designated by the Ministry of Revenue before or within two years of the payment; (d) include board resolutions, underlying contracts, and evidence of beneficial ownership; and (e) await a written determination before recognizing any treaty-reduced rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: For an exempt Samoa International Company, royalties and interest paid to non-residents are subject to 0% Samoan withholding tax. If the International Company is treated as a taxable domestic entity, the statutory non-resident final withholding tax rates are 15% for interest and 15% for royalties, with available treaty rates generally ranging from 0% to 15% depending on the counterparty jurisdiction and beneficial ownership. For an electronic medical record SaaS product, the distinction between SaaS business income and royalty income for 'software use' is fact-sensitive; payments should be characterized by the actual software licensing and hosting structure.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing documentation threshold is publicly codified for a tax-exempt Samoa International Company. Because the company bears no income tax, no Local File or Master File must be filed with the Samoa Ministry of Revenue. However, where the International Company has intercompany transactions with related parties — including EMR software licenses, cloud hosting costs, management fees, or client receivables above WST 1,000,000 per annum — a contemporaneous arm's length benchmark study should be prepared to defend economic substance, pricing integrity, and the absence of a taxable Samoan permanent establishment.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa applies economic substance rules to International Companies carrying on relevant activities, including intellectual property holding, distribution and service centers, finance and leasing, and pure holding company business. A Medical Clinic EMR SaaS entity holding registered software, trademarks, or data rights is likely to be characterized as an intellectual property business or a distribution/service business. The company must demonstrate in Samoa: active decision-making, qualified local employees or an outsourced local function proportionate to the activity, adequate operating expenditure, physical premises, and annual filing of an economic substance return. A pure equity holding company may satisfy a reduced substance test. Where economic substance is not satisfied, the exemption is not automatically a criminal violation, but the company becomes exposed to reassessment, penalties, cancellation, and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abusive Use of International Company Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a shell International Company to invoice Samoan medical clinics for EMR software services, while management, servers, sales activity, and clinical support functions are physically located in Samoa; booking all revenue as tax-exempt offshore income; paying artificial dividends to avoid personal income tax; and using nominee directors with no substantive oversight.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Samoa Ministry of Revenue may disregard the tax-exempt International Company form, treat the Samoan activity as a permanent establishment, and assess the entire net revenue at the relevant domestic corporate income tax rate. In addition, the Tax Administration may impose an evader penalty of up to 200% of the tax avoided, late payment interest, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion under the Income Tax Act 2012, carrying fines up to WST 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to seven years for individuals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and de facto controllers who knowingly engineered the sham are jointly and severally liable for the reassessed tax, penalties, interest, and litigation costs. The Supreme Court of Samoa may pierce the corporate veil, impose travel bans, issue worldwide asset freezing orders, disqualify directors for a specified period, and order civil restitution to the Treasury or defrauded creditors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Economic Substance Failure — IP Holding and SaaS Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The International Company claims exemption and intercompany royalty deductions while performing no research and development, no product management, no server monitoring, no client contracting, and no clinical workflow support in Samoa; no economic substance return is filed; the company is a bare legal owner of EMR software rights only.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Registrar or Ministry of Revenue may declare the International Company economically non-compliant, impose a fixed penalty plus a continuing daily penalty, remove the company from the International Company register, or strike off the company. Economic substance legislation regimes in Samoa allow cancellation of the company's certificate of incorporation and recovery of unpaid government fees with penalty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign a false economic substance declaration are exposed to civil penalties, disqualification, and criminal sanctions for false statements. In serious cases, directors may face a travel ban and personal restitution orders for sums distributed to shareholders while the company was insolvent or non-compliant.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using nominee shareholders to conceal the true beneficial owner of the Medical Clinic EMR SaaS International Company; failing to maintain a beneficial ownership register; transferring subscription revenue through personal accounts or third-party payment processors without AML/CFT screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing Act 2018 of Samoa, a corporate entity may be fined up to WST 1,000,000, and natural persons up to WST 300,000, with imprisonment for up to five years. The Financial Intelligence Unit may also issue asset seizure orders, suspend bank accounts, and impose civil penalties for failure to verify customer identity and report suspicious activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, company secretaries, and resident agents can be personally prosecuted if they knew or recklessly ignored the concealment. Personal liability includes financial penalties, confiscation orders, travel bans, and a prohibition from acting as a director or agent in Samoa for a prescribed period.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The International Company has no employees, no office, no bank account in Samoa, no board meetings, no accounting records, and no real commercial activity; it exists solely to disguise the true vendor of medical EMR software and to defeat the tax authorities of the customers' jurisdictions or Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A court may declare the International Company and its contracts to be shams, void the intercompany agreements, reassess income to the true economic owner, and impose civil fraud penalties. The Registrar may strike off the company for failing to maintain a principal place of business or accounting records. Criminal fraud penalties may apply with imprisonment for up to seven years under the Crimes Act 2013.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced where the company is used for fraud or evasion. Directors and shareholders can be ordered to repay all dividends and distributions received from the shell company, make restitution to customers or the tax authority, and are subject to travel bans and disqualification orders. In extreme cases, custodial sentences are imposed.
